extra_quotes: We evaluate RescuCore on representative Mamba-3 hybrid models using cycle-accurate Accel-Sim simulation, RTL synthesis for area estimation, and synthesis-informed AccelWattch power modeling.
We synthesize the RescuCore RTL using Cadence Genus with the 45nm FreePDK45 library [34], scaling the resulting area and power estimates to 7nm for comparison with an NVIDIA A100 GPU.
Although evaluated on NVIDIA GPUs, the proposed architecture is applicable to other GPUs.
Although training is included in our workload characterization, RescuCore specifically targets inference acceleration.
